item.description:
Gravediggaz - 6 Feet Deep (1994) Gee Street - 314-524 016-2


Gravediggaz was an American hip hop group from New York City. The group formed in 1994, bringing together Prince Paul (The Undertaker), Frukwan (The Gatekeeper), Too Poetic (The Grym Reaper), and RZA (The Rzarector). Gravediggaz are widely recognized as one of the most influential groups of their era and are considered pioneers of the hip-hop subgenre horrorcore.

Gravediggaz fue un grupo estadounidense de hip hop de Nueva York. El grupo se formó en 1994 reuniendo a Prince Paul (The Undertaker), Frukwan (The Gatekeeper), Too Poetic (The Grym Reaper) y RZA (The Rzarector). Gravediggaz son ampliamente reconocidos como uno de los grupos más influyentes de su época y son considerados pioneros en el subgénero del hip-hop, horrorcore.
